title: xi cutscene dialog lines
description: Dialog strings for one cutscene. Each line becomes one entry in the zone's event-message DAT (or one paged entry with '\v' page-prompts). Message ids are assigned by the compiler at build time; refer to lines by 'id' from cutscene steps.

id.description: Stable line id. Referenced by cutscene steps as 'text': '<id>'.

text.description: One string, or an array joined as paged sub-lines with '\v' (▼ prompt). Escapes: \n newline, \v paged-prompt, {player}, {npc}, {auto:N}.

paged.description: If true, and text is an array, produce a single message entry that pages via ▼. If false, each array element becomes its own message id (one dialog box each).

speaker.description: Default speaker for this line (id from cutscene_npc). Overridden by the step's speaker field if set.
